title: Vinod darzi ka card
banner:
Kaam achha, par
dukaan kisi ko milti nahi 🧵
caption:
Vinod ki silai poore mohalle mein mashhoor. Par naya graahak poochta hai, 'number kya hai, dukaan kahan hai?' 👇

linkedin_text: A short illustrated story in Hindi about a tailor whose work everyone praises but whose shop nobody can find, until he has a business card he can share on WhatsApp. ScoreMyBiz is free for 30 days on Google Play.

art.style: Warm hand-painted Indian storybook illustration, soft gouache and watercolour texture, golden-hour lighting, rich detailed everyday Indian settings, expressive faces, gentle nostalgic mood.

cast.Vinod: Vinod is a tailor in his forties, slim, with neatly combed black hair, a measuring tape around his neck, a white half-sleeve shirt and spectacles; a kind, modest face.

scenes.vo: विनोद की सिलाई, पूरे मोहल्ले में मशहूर।
scenes.sub: Vinod ki silai, poore mohalle mein mashhoor.
scenes.art: Vinod the tailor sits at an old sewing machine in a small bright shop, a measuring tape around his neck, colourful fabric rolls stacked behind him, a finished kurta on a hanger, morning light through the shutter.

scenes.vo: शादी का सूट हो या स्कूल की यूनिफ़ॉर्म, सब उसी के पास।
scenes.sub: Shaadi ka suit ho ya school ki uniform, sab usi ke paas.
scenes.art: A proud groom in a sherwani and a small boy in a school uniform stand side by side in front of Vinod's shop as Vinod adjusts the boy's collar, parents smiling behind them.

scenes.vo: पर नया ग्राहक पूछता, दुकान कहाँ है? नंबर क्या है?
scenes.sub: Par naya graahak poochta, 'dukaan kahan hai? Number kya hai?'
scenes.art: A young woman on a busy market street holds her phone and looks around confused, asking a vegetable seller for directions, narrow lanes with many small shop signs, Vinod's shop hidden in a corner.

scenes.vo: विनोद काग़ज़ के टुकड़े पर नंबर लिखता। काग़ज़ खो जाता।
scenes.sub: Vinod kaagaz ke tukde par number likhta. Kaagaz kho jaata.
scenes.art: Vinod writes his phone number on a torn scrap of paper for a customer, in the foreground a similar scrap lies crumpled in a gutter beside a bicycle wheel, soft afternoon light.

scenes.vo: छपा हुआ कार्ड? पाँच सौ का ख़र्च, और हर बार ख़त्म।
scenes.sub: Chhapa hua card? Paanch sau ka kharch, aur har baar khatam.
scenes.art: Vinod at a small printing shop counter looking at a price list with a frown, a stack of printed cards with only two left in the box on his own counter in a small inset picture.

scenes.vo: फिर ऐप में उसने अपना कार्ड बनाया।
scenes.sub: Phir app mein usne apna card banaya.

scenes.vo: नाम, नंबर, दुकान का पता, और व्हाट्सएप पर शेयर।
scenes.sub: Naam, number, dukaan ka pata, aur WhatsApp par share.
scenes.art: Vinod holds up his phone showing a neat digital business card to a smiling customer who looks at it with her own phone in hand, both standing at the shop counter, fabric rolls behind.

scenes.vo: अब हर ग्राहक को, एक टैप में भेज देता है।
scenes.sub: Ab har graahak ko, ek tap mein bhej deta hai.
scenes.art: Vinod sitting at his sewing machine tapping his phone with one thumb, small glowing card icons flying out of the phone towards a row of happy customers' phones drawn faintly in the air.

scenes.vo: और ग्राहक आगे भेजते हैं। मोहल्ले से बाहर भी।
scenes.sub: Aur graahak aage bhejte hain. Mohalle se bahar bhi.
scenes.art: A view over the rooftops of a town at dusk, dotted lines of light connecting phones in many homes back to Vinod's small lit shop in the middle, warm and hopeful.

scenes.vo: इस महीने, तीन शादियों के ऑर्डर। सब नए।
scenes.sub: Is mahine, teen shaadiyon ke order. Sab naye.
scenes.art: Vinod's shop busy and bright with three sets of wedding clothes on hangers, Vinod measuring a young man while two families wait on a bench with sweets, marigolds at the door.

scenes.vo: आपका ग्राहक, आपको कैसे ढूँढता है?
scenes.sub: Aapka graahak, aapko kaise dhoondhta hai?

scenes.vo: स्कोर माय बिज़। तीस दिन मुफ़्त।
